name: comet-hunt
description: Find comets in NASA SPHEREx images. NASA Space Apps 2026.

scripts.dev: npm run db:local && wrangler dev --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply comet-hunt --local --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply comet-hunt --remote --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.test: node web/tests/straight_rules.mjs && node web/tests/search_core.mjs && node web/tests/intro_quality.mjs && node web/tests/cutout_check.mjs && node web/tests/spectrum_check.mjs && node web/tests/rice_check.mjs && node --test worker/sky_index.test.mjs worker/sky_index_full.test.mjs worker/depth.test.mjs && node worker/check_csv.mjs && sh worker/test_contract.sh
